name: Berkeley Lower Extremity Exoskeleton
maker: Berkeley Robotics and Human Engineering Laboratory
def: Lower body powered exoskeleton developed by the Berkeley Robotics and Human Engineering Laboratory at the University of California, Berkeley, with DARPA funding, to add strength to leg movements.
facts: DARPA supplied $50 million in initial funding in 2001
A prototype was shown at the DARPA Technical Symposium in 2004
